title: Tree Height & Depth
definition: The height of a tree is the number of edges on the longest path from the root to a leaf. Often solved recursively as `1 + Math.max(leftHeight, rightHeight)`.
simpleExplanation: Measuring how many generations exist between the Great-Grandparent and the youngest Child.
